item.title: Rebranding
item.description: There is nothing wrong with branding. But when rebranding hits the church of Jesus Christ, we may have gone a bridge too far.

item.title: Justice Jackson's Grammy for Partisan Hackery

item.title: Leftmedia Frets Over Whiteness at Winter Olympics

item.title: Major Medical Groups Are Changing Policy on Treating Gender-Confused Kids
item.description: The American Society of Plastic Surgeons now says there is "insufficient evidence" supporting positive outcomes for kids who've been convinced they are transgender.
